title: SMS Credit Calculation Guide (customer guide, A4, 5 pages)
notes:
The house style for Salesmessage customer-facing guides; every page is a self-contained one-pager. Imitate the structure, density and voice, never the facts.

Structure on every page: a header with the logo on the left and 'CUSTOMER GUIDE' over a date on the right; a light-blue gradient hero band with an eyebrow ('04 / SMS CREDIT CALCULATION'), a 2-line bold headline of 4-6 words, and a one-sentence subtitle; then 2-3 content blocks; and a footer rule with the website, support email and page number. There is no sales CTA button: these are help documents, not ads.

Content blocks used: a highlight banner ('1 SMS segment = 1 credit'); a callout with a blue left bar for one key caveat; definition rows (term / explanation, optionally zebra-striped); a two-column comparison of stat cards (blue tint vs green tint for the contrasting case); a 2x3 grid of example cards (title, small detail line, blue value); a three-column rate table with uppercase blue column headers and a blue bold value column; a label/value table with striped rows; FAQ (bold question, one-sentence answer); and paragraphs whose sentences start with a bold lead-in ('Keep it short. ...').

Voice: plain, practical, second person ('your balance'). Short headings that state the takeaway ('Make every credit count', 'Check before you send'). Numbers are shown as values ('2 credits', '1 / minute'), not buried in prose. About 180-260 words per page, with lots of white space.

Design tokens (A4 at 1191px wide, so 1px = 0.5pt): Inter for everything, bold for headings; H1 28pt, H2 15pt, body about 9.3pt; heading ink #171c28, body #525d6e, accent #24a5df; card tint #eaf6fd, zebra row #f4f8fb, green card tint #e8f6ec, rule #dce8f0, hero gradient #ebfaff to #cfeeff; 36pt side margins and 10pt card radius.
